the global NTU is the key parameter of the adsorptive process and the dimensionless Θo is the key parameter to specify the optimal cycle period.

, for a given adsorbent/adsorbate system, the cooling COP of an adsorption cooling cycle with thermal regeneration can be maximised by optimising the global NTU and the cycle period, which is the ratio between the cooling period and the total cycle period.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the global analysis of refrigeration cycles with thermal regeneration leads to the definition and the use of two key parameters that are sufficient to design and operate adsorption cycles with prescribed performances.
, for a given adsorption pair, the optimal cycle period is the one that maximizes the cooling COP and minimizes the dimensionless outlet temperature at the end, Θo.
the global NTU is the best parameter to specify a cycle, and that the dimensionless outlet temperature is the best parameter of the global NTU.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the optimal cycle period is a function of the adsorbers’ characteristics and of the heat exchangers’ performances.
the optimal cycle period is not a fixed number, but rather a function of the system design and operating conditions.
